_note: Board 1170:4749 — the records TABLE, a second record editor reachable only
from ⌘⇧P. Mounted directly on the probe: `isOpen` is owned by AquibraStudio,
which no agent session may stage.
BOARD won on everything the board and the DOM can both express:
the table's SCALE. 10px semibold column heads, 11px cells, 7px of vertical
air and a 10px row inset (1170:4751/4756 and their cell nodes). It was 13px
cells on 10px padding — the panel's scale inside a 640 modal holding four
columns and three buttons, so the widest column wrapped before the table
filled its frame.
the row's HIERARCHY. 1170:4757/58/59: display value in --color/ink, the next
column ink-soft, a media column at 10px ink-muted. Every cell was one flat
--bk-ink.
the row ACTIONS. 1744:8396/8398/8400 draw bordered white buttons — 22 tall,
radius 4, gray-300 hairline, 11px. They were borderless ghosts, which on a
tinted row read as text rather than as controls.
the FOOT and its CTA. gap 8 (1170:4775), and 12/7 insets at radius 6 with an
11px label (1170:4773/4774) against flowbite xs's 1px, radius 8 and 12px.
Rows are rounded at 6 now, which needed the table off `border-collapse` — a
collapsed table cannot round a <tr>.
NOT anchored, and why. Six targets, and the first four are one cause:
1170:4751 thead, 1170:4756 / 1170:4761 the rows. The board draws them as
FLEX rows and states gap / padding-left / padding-top on the row itself. CSS
applies none of the three to a <tr>: the air lives in the cells. The visual
values ARE conformed above (the 12 gap read as `px-1.5` per cell, the 10
inset as `first:pl-2.5`, the 7 as the cells' `py`), but the property pair the
harness would compare does not exist on either side. Keeping a real <table>
is deliberate — a four-column grid with row actions is what table semantics
are for, and a board is a picture, not a markup instruction.
Their four th and twelve td text nodes carry `w-[170px]` / `w-[56px]` /
`w-[88px]` / `w-[72px]` — column widths for the board's own sample
collection. A table sizes columns from content, and this modal renders the
leading three fields of WHATEVER collection is picked.
1744:8390 the collection Select: 32 tall at radius 4 on the board, 42 at
radius 8 live. That is chrome-ui Select's own theme, the same 10px and the
same radius step as the text input boards.json holds at
`authority=open:input-fill` — a chrome-wide control is not re-settled by one
screen. Recorded in the report beside the 42-vs-32 input.
1170:4750 the title: 13 on the board, 14 live, from the shared
MODAL_TITLE_CLASS that every modal board is measured against.
1170:4749 the frame: the board states px16/py14/gap10 on the dialog box,
where the compound ModalContent puts its insets on ModalTitle and ModalBody
and measures 0 on the frame itself. Shared primitive, different composition.
1170:4771/4772 Import JSON — not built, and the board's own node name says
so. The engine creates content items one at a time; parsing and fanning a
file over N creates is a feature, not this modal's layout.
1170:4776 a 6px spacer frame; four hotspot/* nodes.
contrastScope is the modal itself, not `[data-probe]`: ModalRoot portals to
the overlay root, which sits OUTSIDE the probe wrapper — scoped to the wrapper
the contrast sweep and the copy check both read an empty subtree and reported
zero of everything.
